flow.metadata.update([("vm_run_id", value)] + extra_pairs)
flow.metadata.update(extra_pairs + [("firewall_name", value)])
flow.metadata.update((("firewall_action", value),) + extra_pairs)
flow.metadata = dict(extra_pairs + (("firewall_permission", value),))
flow.metadata.update(zip(["firewall_base"] + extra_keys, values))
flow.metadata.update(dict.fromkeys(extra_keys + ("firewall_error",), value))
flow.metadata.update([*({("auth_cache_hit", value)} | extra_pair_set)])
flow.metadata.update([("external", "vm_run_id")] + extra_pairs)
flow.metadata.update(extra_pairs + [("external", "firewall_name")])
flow.metadata.update(extra_pairs + more_pairs)
flow.metadata.update([*([("vm_proxy_log_path", value)] + extra_pairs)])
